summary: GOWell Energy Technology filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated November 11, 2026, announcing that its Singapore operating subsidiary, GOWell Technology Singapore Pte. Ltd., completed the acquisition of Aberdeen-based Well-Sense Holdings Ltd (WellSense), a provider of distributed fiber optic sensing and well integrity diagnostic technologies. Financial terms were not disclosed; the deal was funded from existing cash. No board recommendation or advisors were named. The transaction folds WellSense's FiberLine Intervention technology into GOWell's well-logging portfolio, its first acquisition as a public company. Watch integration execution and customer continuity; no arbitrage angle given undisclosed, completed cash terms.
